title: Push preview names WordPress records and fields in the Owner's words
steps: Run the changeset, live-write and real MariaDB push cases for preview labels and page kinds.
expect: A menu item without its own title takes its target page's title.
Featured image, page template and alt text carry a label and the page title, never the meta key.
Pages keep their page kind through Preview, Apply and Undo.

cmd: --test-name-pattern=page types and translated metadata|record title without exposing|native menu object titles|retain localized record descriptions
tests: WordPress preview retains page types and translated metadata labels
WordPress metadata uses the record title without exposing unknown internal keys
WordPress preview uses native menu object titles and skips trash bookkeeping
Apply and Undo retain localized record descriptions
